name: Respawn in Hardcore
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: Arinn
description: Adds a Respawn button to the Hardcore death screen so you can keep playing after death while your world stays Hardcore. If you’ve already died and are stuck in Spectator mode, you can install the mod and use /hardcorerespawn to continue playing.
evidence: Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-25 (8dfda948) (36 classes, 68 members). Not run yet.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
